summary: Theme accent derivation is sound: Everforest orange #E69875 reaches 9.11:1 on black and 8.52:1 on the shell pill, with a 7.40:1 adaptive navy glyph; off toggles reach 11.95:1 and secondary shell text is above 11:1. Themes selected-row highlight is only 1.21:1 on black but is not the sole state cue: white name/bullet reach 17.37:1 and a thumbnail identifies the selection. No blocker or major accessibility defect found.

findings.title: Power uptime ink misses WCAG AA by a small margin
findings.detail: UPTIME_PX is 8.0 logical px (about 12 device px at 1.5 scale), so it is normal text, yet SECONDARY_TEXT (112,112,120) on black is 4.28:1, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold. Raising the neutral to (116,116,124) #74747C gives 4.53:1 while preserving the reference's cool-neutral look.

findings.title: Lock caption does not follow the active theme accent
findings.detail: The center Power disc uses the derived theme accent, but the caption below it stays fixed at (201,207,233). In reference/panel-power.png the caption is #79A1F5, matching the active disc. Under the intentional Everforest theme the disc is #E69875 while the caption remains pale blue, leaving the active-state accent language inconsistent. Contrast is not failing (caption on black 13.59:1); render the caption in the derived theme accent with the same readable/ink_on treatment.

what_would_make_it_a_10: Lift the Power uptime ink to at least #74747C and render the Lock caption in the derived theme accent so it tracks the active disc; keep the current adaptive ink logic and Everforest orange unchanged.
